method: NHTSA vPIC GetMakesForVehicleType for passenger car and motorcycle retrieved 2026-11-20 (195 passenger-car makes and 1703 motorcycle makes before removing equipment-like names; 7 makes occur in both categories). Model-list endpoints returned HTTP 403 during that retrieval, so model rows are the local supplement retained for offline use, including Dodge Dart and common passenger-car and motorcycle models. python3 scripts/refresh-catalog.py retries upstream and keeps this file if the request fails.
